label: Debt / EBITDA (x)
note: My design. Bands loosely follow typical rating-agency leverage ranges (investment grade ~<3x, high yield >4x).

label: Net Debt / EBITDA (x)
note: My design. Same idea as Debt/EBITDA after subtracting cash.

label: EBITDA / Interest (x)
note: My design. Coverage under ~3x is usually speculative grade.

label: Fixed Charge Coverage (x)
note: My design. (EBITDA - capex - taxes) / interest; below 1.0x means cash after capex does not cover interest.

label: Debt / Capital
note: My design. Negative equity gives a value above 1.0 and the worst band.

label: (OCF - Capex) / Debt
note: My design. Share of debt that one year of free cash flow could repay.
